userStories.title: Gitignore the three untracked runtime artifacts
userStories.description: As an operator, I need the sidecar-session, ship-stalled, and plan-preflight-failed runtime files gitignored so that an untracked runtime artifact never dirties the working tree and never trips the clean-tree plan preflight (the CAM-115 false-refusal trigger).
acceptanceCriteria: .gitignore contains an entry for .claude/.cam-sidecar-session.json. [oracle: grep -q '.claude/.cam-sidecar-session.json' .gitignore]
.gitignore contains an entry for .claude/.cam-ship-stalled.json. [oracle: grep -q '.claude/.cam-ship-stalled.json' .gitignore]
.gitignore contains an entry for .claude/.cam-plan-preflight-failed.json. [oracle: grep -q '.claude/.cam-plan-preflight-failed.json' .gitignore]

The clean-tree preflight gate is unchanged: still strict git status --porcelain, never loosened to -uno (AC7). [oracle: grep -q -- '--porcelain' src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts && ! grep -q -- '--porcelain=' src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts && ! grep -q -- '-uno' src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Quality spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: .gitignore only. Place the three entries next to the existing sibling .claude/.cam-plan-escalated.json (.gitignore:85), same path style. These are the three runtime artifacts currently untracked and not ignored (AC1 of the issue spec). Do NOT touch src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts: AC7 explicitly rejects loosening the gate to -uno; the trigger is resolved by this gitignore hygiene plus the surfacing stories that follow.

userStories.title: Durable plan-preflight-failed marker module
userStories.description: As the sidecar supervisor, I need a durable marker module for plan-preflight failures (read/write/remove plus a detail-truncation helper) so that later stories can persist and surface a preflight death across orchestrator recycles, mirroring the plan-escalated marker precedent.
acceptanceCriteria: New module src/supervisor/plan-preflight-marker.ts exports a filename constant whose value is .cam-plan-preflight-failed.json (relative to .claude/, mirroring PLAN_ESCALATED_FILENAME). [oracle: grep -q 'cam-plan-preflight-failed.json' src/supervisor/plan-preflight-marker.ts]

The marker interface has exactly { step: string, detail: string, writtenAt: string } and no issueId field (preflight failures are environment problems, issue-agnostic). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight-marker.test.ts]

A writer-params type Omit<Marker, 'writtenAt'> is exported (mirroring PlanEscalationWriterParams, plan-runner.ts:788) so the pure loop never stamps timestamps. [oracle: grep -q "Omit<" src/supervisor/plan-preflight-marker.ts]

The read helper shape-guards all three fields (step: string, detail: string, writtenAt: string), returns null on missing file, malformed JSON, non-object, array, or any wrong-typed field, and never throws (patterns.md 'JSON reader shape guards'). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight-marker.test.ts]

Write overwrites any previous marker and never throws; remove is a best-effort unlink that never throws when the file is absent (mirrors writePlanEscalatedMarker / removePlanEscalatedMarker). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight-marker.test.ts]

A pure truncation helper returns detail unchanged when single-line, and first line plus a ' (+N more)' suffix when detail spans multiple lines (N = number of additional lines); covered by tests for both cases (AC4). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight-marker.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Quality spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: src/supervisor/plan-preflight-marker.ts (new), test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight-marker.test.ts (new). Mirror src/supervisor/plan-escalation.ts verbatim in structure (filename constant, interface, read with shape guard, write, remove, doc comments); it is the closer and newer sibling. Field name is writtenAt, NOT ts (ship-stalled uses ts; the issue spec says follow plan-escalated). node:fs existsSync/readFileSync/writeFileSync/unlinkSync are the established pattern in the sibling modules; keep it. The truncation helper lives here because both the US-003 notify line and the US-005 boot-blocker prose reference the same rule.

userStories.title: preflight-failed arm in runPostAuditAction with marker write and notify
userStories.description: As the orchestrator operator, I need a plan-preflight failure to write the durable marker and push a one-line pane narration (instead of silently falling through to no-action) so that the failure is visible live and survives an orchestrator recycle.
acceptanceCriteria: PostAuditActionResult gains a distinct { kind: 'preflight-failed' } member, and runPostAuditAction has an explicit arm for planResult.kind === 'preflight-failed' placed before the generic non-approved fall-through (currently plan-runner.ts:1147). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-postaudit.test.ts]

The arm invokes an injected marker-writer seam with { step, detail } carrying the FULL untruncated detail; the pure loop passes only the writer-params (no writtenAt). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-postaudit.test.ts]

The arm fires notifyFn with a one-line narration containing the step and the detail truncated per the US-002 helper (first line plus (+N more)), format mirroring the existing ship-stalled/plan-escalated pane lines (step then detail). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-postaudit.test.ts]

The production seam in sidecar.ts stamps writtenAt (ISO 8601) and writes the marker to .claude/.cam-plan-preflight-failed.json, mirroring makeWriteEscalationMarkerFn (sidecar.ts:1696); it is wired into runPostPlanActions. [oracle: bun test]
exitPhaseAfterPlan (sidecar.ts:1600) handles the new kind by reverting phase to idle. [oracle: bun test]

The existing plan-preflight-failed event write in runPlanPhase (plan-runner.ts:755, events.ts) is unchanged: this story adds marker plus notify, it does not touch the event. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Quality spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts (PostAuditActionResult union at :932, runPostAuditAction options + arm), src/commands/sidecar.ts (new makeWritePreflightFailedMarkerFn factory next to makeWriteEscalationMarkerFn:1696, wiring in runPostPlanActions:1746, exitPhaseAfterPlan:1600), test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-postaudit.test.ts. GOTCHA (issue spec): at the point preflight fails inside runPlanPhase (plan-runner.ts:748-758) notifyFn is NOT in scope (only logEvent is); marker write and notify MUST happen one layer up in runPostAuditAction where notifyFn is already constructed. notifyFn (makeNotifyOrchestrator, host.ts:198) is best-effort silent no-op when the orch pane is gone: the durable marker is the source of truth, so write the marker regardless of notify outcome (write before or independent of notify). Follow the seam pattern: optional writer fn in the options bag, ?? no-op default, exactly like writeEscalationMarkerFn (plan-runner.ts:815, :849).

userStories.title: Marker removal on any non-preflight-failed plan result (Option B)
userStories.description: As the orchestrator operator, I need the preflight-failed marker removed whenever a plan attempt produces any result other than preflight-failed so that 'marker present' always means 'the LAST plan attempt died in preflight' and a stale marker never outlives a healthy attempt.
acceptanceCriteria: runPostAuditAction invokes an injected marker-remove seam (best-effort) for every planResult whose kind is not preflight-failed; removal is not gated on convergence and not gated on issueId. Verified for at least three representative kinds (e.g. audit-approved, planner-failed, mutex-busy). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-postaudit.test.ts]
The remove seam is NOT invoked when planResult.kind is preflight-failed (the arm writes, never unlinks its own marker). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-postaudit.test.ts]

The production seam in sidecar.ts wires the US-002 remove helper against .claude/.cam-plan-preflight-failed.json in runPostPlanActions (sibling of removeEscalationMarkerFn wiring); it never throws when the file is already absent. [oracle: bun test]

The existing plan-escalated marker removal semantics (removeEscalationMarkerFn gated on proceed-branch convergence, plan-runner.ts) are unchanged. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-postaudit.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Quality spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts, src/commands/sidecar.ts, test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-postaudit.test.ts. DESIGN CONTRAST to keep straight: the plan-escalated marker is removed only on convergence for the same flow (removeEscalationMarkerFn fires in the proceed-branch path); this NEW marker uses Option B (remove on ANY non-preflight-failed result) because preflight failures are issue-agnostic environment problems (spec AC5 + gotchas). Do not unify the two removal policies. Cleanest placement: fire the remove seam early in runPostAuditAction before the kind dispatch, guarded on kind !== 'preflight-failed'.
